attributes.title: 2027 Maryland Chapter Annual Scientific Meeting
attributes.series: ACP Maryland Chapter Annual Scientific Meeting
attributes.summary:
The Maryland Chapter of the American College of Physicians holds its 2027 Annual Scientific Meeting on Friday and Saturday, February 19 and 20, at Turf Valley Resort & Conference Center in Ellicott City, west of Baltimore.

On Saturday the chapter also runs the Richard B. Williams ACP Medical Student Conference, which includes a student abstract competition with posters. ACP said more details were coming when we checked. Fees, credit hours and lodging had not been posted, so check the chapter's news and meetings page before you plan.
